#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --partition=Compute
#SBATCH --job-name=v3-loss-audit
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=2
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --time=00:10:00
#SBATCH --chdir=/data/wushangge/CULS_LiteCut/runs/20261117T160747Z-v3-ranking-loss-audit-51be3133/src
#SBATCH --output=/data/wushangge/CULS_LiteCut/runs/20261117T160747Z-v3-ranking-loss-audit-51be3133/logs/audit-%j.out
#SBATCH --error=/data/wushangge/CULS_LiteCut/runs/20261117T160747Z-v3-ranking-loss-audit-51be3133/logs/audit-%j.err
#SBATCH --export=NONE
set -Eeuo pipefail
export PATH=/home/share/process/anaconda3/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
export TMPDIR=/data/wushangge/CULS_LiteCut/runs/20261117T160747Z-v3-ranking-loss-audit-51be3133/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=/data/wushangge/CULS_LiteCut/runs/20261117T160747Z-v3-ranking-loss-audit-51be3133/cache
set +e
CHECK_ORIGINAL_LOSS=1 python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_ranking_loss.py -v > /data/wushangge/CULS_LiteCut/runs/20261117T160747Z-v3-ranking-loss-audit-51be3133/logs/original-loss-red.out 2>&1
red_exit=$?
set -e
if [ "$red_exit" -ne 1 ]; then exit 2; fi
python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_ranking_loss.py -v
python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_learned_ports.py -v
python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_v3_ranking.py -v
python -B scripts/audit_v3_ranking_loss.py --prepared /data/wushangge/CULS_LiteCut/runs/20261117T075734Z-joint-v3-learning-fixed-bade277a/output/prepared/prepared.pt --old-run /data/wushangge/CULS_LiteCut/runs/20261117T075734Z-joint-v3-learning-fixed-bade277a --output /data/wushangge/CULS_LiteCut/runs/20261117T160747Z-v3-ranking-loss-audit-51be3133/output/audit

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --partition=Compute
#SBATCH --job-name=v3-ranking-loss
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=2
#SBATCH --mem=20G
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --time=00:30:00
#SBATCH --chdir=/data/wushangge/CULS_LiteCut/runs/20261117T161028Z-v3-ranking-loss-fit-a3a6caf6/src

export V3_SOURCE_COMMIT=9cb306e8cc24745e28a2e9664b8c45fa6b469627

done
